meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 把目录、网址、粘贴的笔记或当前对话的工作内容，整理成可复用的技能文件（SKILL.md)；也能读取已有技能，原地更新并合并新经验。
howto.when: 当你说“/learn”、“learn this”、“capture this workflow”等触发词，或要求把某内容变成技能、改进/更新某技能时触发。

say.note: 读取目录并生成一个使用该项目的技能

say.text: 把我们刚才做的事变成技能
say.note: 从对话中提炼可复用的流程

say.text: 更新一下‘部署’这个技能
say.note: 读取并原地合并新的经验

howto.what_en: Turns a directory, URL, pasted notes, or the current conversation into a reusable skill file (SKILL.md); can also read an existing skill and update it in place with new learnings.
howto.when_en: Triggers on “/learn”, “learn this”, “capture this workflow” and similar requests to turn content into a skill or update an existing skill.

say_en.note: Reads the directory and creates a skill for it.

say_en.text: Turn what we just did into a skill
say_en.note: Distills the conversation into a repeatable workflow.
Reads it and merges the new learnings.
